Name: Succulents for Json Assets (2 Crops and 10 Craftables)
Author: DustBeauty
Description:
[b]. 2 new succulents crops: [/b]
Takes a long time to grow and regrow, but available throughout spring, summer and fall, no need to irrigate every day if you place them near water.
Edible succulents produce fresh sap, Decorative succulents produce succulents starter(seeds). Both have a small chance to drop multiple produce.
Buy at Sandy's shop.

[b]. 10 potted succulents to craft:
[/b]They can be placed anywhere you like. Craft them with cactus fruit and clay.
Unlock the recipes by leveling up the farming skill.
Some recipes can only be purchased from Sandy.

[b].  Chinese and Korean (by KAYA) translation included.[/b]
